For decades, 𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗿𝗼𝘀𝗰𝗹𝗲𝗿𝗼𝘀𝗶𝘀 has been viewed primarily as a disorder of cholesterol, hypertension, and lifestyle. Recent research suggests the picture may be more complex.

The 𝗴𝘂𝘁–𝗵𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘁 𝗮𝘅𝗶𝘀 is emerging as an important contributor to cardiovascular health, with growing evidence that the gut microbiome influences vascular inflammation and plaque development.

𝙺̲𝚎̲𝚢̲ ̲𝚒̲𝚗̲𝚜̲𝚒̲𝚐̲𝚑̲𝚝̲𝚜̲ ̲𝚏̲𝚛̲𝚘̲𝚖̲ ̲𝚛̲𝚎̲𝚌̲𝚎̲𝚗̲𝚝̲ ̲𝚛̲𝚎̲𝚜̲𝚎̲𝚊̲𝚛̲𝚌̲𝚑̲:
🔹 Gut dysbiosis is consistently associated with atherosclerosis, from early plaque formation to advanced disease.

🔹 Microbial metabolites (particularly TMAO) have emerged as key mediators linking diet, the gut microbiome, and cardiovascular risk.

🔹 Impaired gut barrier function may promote systemic inflammation by allowing microbial products to enter the circulation, potentially accelerating plaque progression.

🔹 Advances in multi-omics are helping identify microbiome-derived pathways that could become future biomarkers or therapeutic targets.

👉 𝗕𝗼𝘁𝘁𝗼𝗺 𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲:
The gut microbiome is no longer just an interesting association; it is becoming another piece of the complex cardiovascular puzzle.
While the biological evidence is increasingly compelling, the field is still evolving. The major challenges ahead are establishing causality, identifying which microbial pathways truly drive disease, and translating these findings into effective clinical interventions.

EBANX and Pagaleve are making installment payments through Pix more accessible.

Through our new partnership, we're introducing Pix 4x: a Buy Now, Pay Later solution that lets consumers split purchases into 4 interest-free installments using Pix.

Brazil has a long-established culture of paying in installments, but around 60 million people still don't have access to credit cards. With Pix 4x, merchants can reach these consumers, as well as many others with low credit limits, without adding complexity to checkout.

Here's what the opportunity looks like:

➡️ Brazil's digital commerce market is projected to reach US$516 billion by 2028, growing 54% from 2025.
➡️ Installment payments already account for 47% of e-commerce transaction value in the country.
➡️ EBANX data shows installments can increase AOV by up to 2.7x, while merchants offering them have seen average revenue growth of 20%.

By combining Pagaleve's AI-powered instant credit analysis with EBANX's global merchant network, we're helping businesses expand access, reduce payment friction, and unlock new growth opportunities in one of the world's most dynamic digital commerce markets.

#EBANX #payments #pix

Expanding payment options at checkout does more than increase coverage. It can also increase revenue from the very same customers by supporting different purchasing moments, preferences, and payment behaviors.

Our latest article by Flávia Faria on EBANX Insights explores why payment diversification is a growth strategy in itself. EBANX data across retail, gaming, and SaaS shows how consumers move between payment methods throughout their purchasing journey, and how that behavior translates into measurable business results.

In Brazil, for instance, 18% of customers who made their first purchase with Pix later switched to a credit card, increasing their average order value by 86%. And when a card payment fails, offering Pix as an alternative can recover transactions that would otherwise be lost.

Read the full analysis here: https://hubs.ly/Q04qWNlg0 

#EBANX #payments

Global payment acceptance doesn't always come from global payment methods. In many emerging markets, local card schemes play a key role in reaching more consumers.

Argentina is one example of this shift. As the local payments landscape has evolved, domestic card networks have become increasingly relevant for businesses looking to maximize acceptance and better serve local consumers.

The same pattern can be seen across many emerging markets. While global card brands remain essential, they're not always enough to maximize acceptance and reach. Integrating local card schemes can help merchants connect with consumers who may not be accessible through international card brands alone.

Read the full analysis by Javier Kaniewicz and Fabiane Ziolla Menezes on EBANX Insights: ﻿https://hubs.ly/Q04qqzTL0

#EBANX #payments

We’ve rolled out improvements to Stripe Directory to make it easier to find the best companies to help you and your agent:

1. Available to all businesses, builders, and agents. Stripe-powered or not. You (or your agent) can install the Stripe CLI and immediately run `stripe directory search` to find the right solution. No Stripe account login required. 

2. Instant business listings: When you make your Stripe profile public, there’s no longer a 24 hour lag to appear in search results. Builders and agents will be able to find you immediately.

3. MCP listings: Stripe profiles that support MCP will now have their endpoints included in search results. Filter results by MCP only via --mcp-supported too! And to help agents find agent-ready businesses easier, we’ve given results with MCP or MPP endpoints a small boost in the results rankings.

What would you like to see next in Stripe Directory? Let us know in the replies. 

A few ideas we’re considering:
* Business health metrics factoring into results
* Curated lists by third parties 
* Offering physical goods in the results and buying them via agentic commerce

If any of those interest you, my DMs are open or email us at directory@stripe.com!
